//: omo (oh-my-openagent) agent config, seeded to ~/.config/opencode/oh-my-openagent.json by postCreate.sh. The plugin itself auto-installs via opencode.json's `plugin` field on first `opencode` launch — no `bunx oh-my-openagent install` TUI needed.
//split: Aligned to omo's agent-model-matching guide, mapped onto our gateway models. COMMUNICATORS (sisyphus/prometheus/metis/atlas/sisyphus-junior) use Kimi — the guide's top Claude-alternative (Kimi > GLM; deepseek/minimax/qwen are explicitly discouraged for these roles, esp. as orchestrator). UTILITY runners (explore/librarian) use Qwen (fast, the guide's utility pick). VISION (multimodal-looker) uses gemini-2.5-flash. The DEEP SPECIALISTS (hephaestus/oracle/momus) are intentionally NOT overridden — they keep omo's built-in GPT defaults and run on OpenCode's native OpenAI/ChatGPT provider (connected via `opencode auth login`), which the guide requires and which satisfies guards like no-hephaestus-non-gpt.
//agents: Run `bunx oh-my-openagent doctor` to verify resolution. atlas is on kimi-k2.7 because the guide lists a tuned Atlas prompt path for K2.7; the maintainer's example config uses kimi-k3 there too if you prefer the newer model.
//categories: Agents delegate work by CATEGORY, not model. Override the categories whose omo defaults we can't serve directly (visual-engineering/artistry default to google/gemini-3.1-pro — we route a Gemini via the gateway instead). `deep` and `ultrabrain` are intentionally left to omo's GPT defaults (deep/max-reasoning work = GPT per the guide), served by the ChatGPT subscription.
//tmux: tmux is installed in the image (Dockerfile). Spawns omo's background subagents into panes; activates only when opencode is launched inside a tmux session (`tmux` then `opencode`), else a harmless no-op (interactive_bash still works). TUNED for a TALL/NARROW terminal (VS Code panel docked right, top-to-bottom): main-horizontal stacks the main pane on TOP and subagents BELOW (splits by height, not width), and the min-widths are at the schema floor so panes still spawn in a narrow column. If you move the terminal to the bottom (wide/short), switch layout back to main-vertical and raise main_pane_min_width to ~120.
//background_task: High concurrency for parallel agent work. Priority: modelConcurrency > providerConcurrency > defaultConcurrency. `litellm` (the local gateway, used by most agents) is set high because the gateway itself fans each request across many upstream providers; providers not listed here use defaultConcurrency.
//aids: Enable all coding aids. hashline_edit = hash-anchored edit tool (no stale-line errors). experimental.task_system defaults true since v3.14; aggressive_truncation defaults false.
//team_mode: Parallel multi-agent coordination (12 team_* tools), OFF by default in omo — enabled here. Opt-in per use: enabling it only makes the tools available. tmux_visualization gives each member a pane (activates only inside a tmux session, like the tmux block above). base_dir is set under the persisted ~/.local/share/opencode volume so user-scope team specs survive rebuilds (project-scope teams live in <repo>/.omo and persist via the bind mount).
